text:
Outcome: Publish the qualified JVM dependency chain, qualify the Native zero-hash repair,
configure verified Central namespaces/signing, and deploy the existing docs to GitHub Pages.

Scope: User authorized items 1-4 on 2026-10-15. Preserve upstream primary checkouts and
their newer commits. Release branches start at the already tested dependency revisions.
No change to the supported-platform promise or stable API boundary is assumed.

Invariants: Mote owns work; one primary and one helper; one heavy gate at a time.
Exact committed candidates need independent review. Secrets must never enter logs/chat.
Public Maven availability, source qualification, and deployed revision are separate evidence.

Relevant paths: tools/release, docs/release-preparation.md, docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md,
tools/native-runtime, docs-site, .github/workflows/docs.yml. Upstream release manifest:
tools/release/dependency-candidates.json. Native baseline: scala-native v0.5.12, 65dd513d.

Change: Permanent release metadata and fixed dependency versions for nine JVM artifacts;
test a guarded zero-hash cache write in upstream java.lang.String; use the installed
sbt-typelevel Central route; add base-aware Astro Pages build/deploy.

Acceptance: Named Native regression fails on original runtime and passes with repair,
with string/hash collection controls and debug/release coverage. Upstream tests, actual
POM closure, signed artifact verification, and fresh Central binary consumer pass.
Docs full verification passes, exact SHA receives independent review, deployed URL serves
the expected base-path pages/assets. Record publication coordinates and deployment run.

Risk/escalation: Namespace ownership and credential location are pending owner input.
Do not substitute a runtime fork or drop Native without a separate scope decision.

Next action: Run the upstream Native reproducer and prepare isolated Pages/release changes.
